5226-5267-7924.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

3263-4247-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-4247-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-4247-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

3755-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
3755-4687-5115.description:
Activate Elven Chorus by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1793-3899-6249--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

997-1385-1981-2415.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

2935-4591-8089.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

4153-5231--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4153-5231--5--195.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

1865-2232-7827-7829.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
1865-2232-7827-7829.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6138.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6138.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4017-7362.notablePrerequisites:
Casey has lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
4017-7362.description:
Gain life.
Casey triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Casey triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 2.

240-3967-4359-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4689-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-2921-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-4659-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2034-2048-4871-6747-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sami.
Repeat.

2034-4681-5170-6794.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3259-3263-5953-6968.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
3259-3263-5953-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-5953-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2060-2510-4415-6930.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2060-2510-4415-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1414-2854-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-2854-4574-6650.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2173-5220-5256-6537.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1976-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2558-2829-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2829-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3080-3557-5299.notablePrerequisites: Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3080-3557-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago, triggering it, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3174-5147-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
3174-5147-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-5436-5742-5743.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1418-4499-4939.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2067-2542-5274.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each creature you control.
2067-2542-5274.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Dwarven Song by paying {R}, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Dwarven Song.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.

1333-1626-4050-4125.notablePrerequisites: At least two of your opponents have a creature card in their graveyard.
1333-1626-4050-4125.description:
Cast Ghouls' Night Out by paying {3}{B}{B}, returning Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard to the battlefield, and at least two other creatures from your opponents' graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghouls' Night Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser and the two creatures your opponents own, adding {1}{B}{B}.
When the three creatures die, Headless Rider triggers three times, creating three 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Zombies, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2353-4591-4691.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-4591-4691.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

514-3234-3263-4659-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
514-3234-3263-4659-4826.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two other lands, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {4} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of World Shaper.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Mycosynth Gardens, adding {C}{C}.
The Mycosynth Gardens dies, triggering its second ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

1167-1434-2047.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Mindslaver.
Activate the token Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

573-1479-2692.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-2692.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Felidar Retreat, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
